items.title_orig: What are some famous examples of largely beloved bands screwing over a "classic era line-up" member?
items.article_text:
Dave Abbruzzese was the classic era drummer for Pearl Jam. He took over just before they toured Ten and then played on Vs and most of Vitalogy. Then before Vitalogy was done he was kicked out of the band over political disagreements, stemming the Ticketmaster boycott, and the band thinking he wasn't with it, apparently he bought a sportscar and Eddie didn't like that.
 Fast forward to 2017, Pearl Jam get into the Rock n Roll Hall of Fame. Abbruzzese being the classic era drummer was surely inducted right? Nope, the only drummers included are Dave Krusen (who played on Ten) and Matt Cameron (drummer from 1998 to 2025). Most insiders generally believe that Pearl Jam didn't want Abbruzzese inducted and either asked he not be included or didn't advocate for his inclusion.
